subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding symmetry and identifying lines of symmetry in a shape
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student folds a virtual paper shape to test whether the two halves match
exercise.pictorial: Student draws a line of symmetry on pictured shapes
exercise.abstract: Student identifies which shapes/letters have a line of symmetry without a visual fold aid

misconception_flags: draws a line of symmetry that does not produce two mirror-matching halves

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
